en.venue_notices: Notices on the venues' own sites
en.venue_notices_hint: Opening hours are stored as a weekly pattern, so nothing here can say “closed 1 January”. This reads each venue's own page and quotes what it found. It never changes your plan — check it yourself.
en.venue_notices_none: No dated closure notice was found on any site.
en.venue_notices_advisory: A quote is not a fact. It may be about the website, an exhibition or building work rather than the venue closing.
en.landing_headline: Plan a trip that actually fits the day
en.landing_subtext: Tell it who is going and what you like. It finds real places, checks opening hours and travel time, and builds a day-by-day timetable you can print.
en.landing_bullet_places: Finds places from OpenStreetMap and ranks them against your taste
en.landing_bullet_schedule: Builds a timetable that respects opening hours, walking and transit
en.landing_bullet_money: Tracks the budget and splits shared bills between travellers
en.landing_bullet_export: Exports an Excel workbook and a calendar file for the whole trip
en.landing_how_setup: Answer a short form: dates, who is coming, what you enjoy.
en.landing_how_places: Swipe through suggested places and keep the ones you want.
en.landing_how_plan: Generate a draft plan and see what it assumed to build it.
en.landing_how_use: Activate it, then use the itinerary, checklist and cost sheets.
en.landing_local_note: Everything runs on this machine. No account, no upload — your trip stays in a file on your own disk.
en.landing_free_note: Finding places, ranking, planning and exporting are free. Only a few optional extras cost money, and each one shows its price before you press it.
en.no_trips_yet: No trips yet. Create the first one on the right.
en.destination_help: The city name is what gets searched on the map, so keep it in English or the local spelling. A city that is not in the list still works — type it.
en.trip_name_help: Only for finding this trip again later. Change it to anything you like.
en.setup_intro_lead: The next four steps ask about your trip and your group. Nothing here is final — you can come back and change any answer, and every step saves as you go.
en.setup_intro_basics: Dates and times — when you arrive and leave, and whether a hotel is booked. Skip anything you do not know yet.
en.setup_intro_style: What you enjoy — a few taps. This is what decides which places get suggested to you first.
en.setup_intro_travellers: Who else is coming — their ages and tastes, so the plan suits everyone, not only you.
en.setup_intro_requirements: Hard requirements — the things the plan must respect, like a nap after lunch or no long walks.
en.setup_intro_next: After this you will pick places, then the planner builds the timetable.
en.setup_basics_help: Leave a box unticked when you do not know the answer yet. Without dates the planner suggests how many days to stay instead of a timetable.
en.setup_style_help: Tap anything that sounds like you. Main style is the only required answer, and more taps mean better suggestions — not a longer trip.
en.setup_travellers_help: Travelling alone? Leave the number at zero and go on. Otherwise add each person — ages matter, because a plan good for adults can be too much for a child or a grandparent.
en.setup_requirements_help: This is the one box the planner treats as a rule rather than a preference. Everything you ticked earlier is a taste; what you write here is a constraint.
en.owner_description_placeholder: I get tired after lunch and like a slow morning. I would rather see two places properly than five in a rush.
en.owner_must_placeholder:
Back at the hotel before 21:00.
No more than 20 minutes walking at a time.
Keep 1 January free for family.
en.owner_must_help: One requirement per line. Say what must be true, not what you would prefer.
en.member_notes_placeholder: Loves aquariums, bored by museums, needs a snack every couple of hours.
en.member_tags_help: Their taste, not yours. It is weighted beside everyone else's so no one person decides the whole trip.
en.member_count_help: Everyone except you. Set the number and a card appears for each person.
en.owner_age_help: Used for pacing and for opening-hour rules that depend on age. Leave it blank if you would rather not say.
en.accommodation_help_unknown: You have not decided where to stay. The planner will recommend an area to look in, based on the places you choose.
en.accommodation_help_not_booked: You know you need a room but have not booked one. Same as above: the planner recommends an area, and days are built around the centre of your places.
en.accommodation_help_booked: A room is booked. Add the address on the Evidence screen and every day is built out from that exact point instead of an estimate.
en.shortlist_help: Everything you have kept so far. The planner schedules must-do first, then interested, then maybe.
en.shortlist_empty: Nothing kept yet. Swipe right or press a keep button on a card below.
en.draft_shape: What the plan looks like so far
en.draft_shape_help: A rough total from the visit estimates on the cards you kept. The planner adds travel, meals and rest on top when it builds the real timetable.
en.drag_hint: Drag the card — right to keep, left to drop, down to skip. The buttons do the same thing.
en.photos_load_themselves: Photos and descriptions load on their own as you go, free from Wikipedia.
en.plan_draft_note: This is a draft. Nothing is committed until you press the button at the bottom, and generating another one leaves any active plan untouched.
en.assumptions_help: The planner fills a gap rather than refusing. Each line is something it did not know and had to stand in for — fix any of them on the Evidence screen and generate again.
en.assumption_none: Nothing was assumed: every place and route in this draft is backed by evidence.
en.assumption_no_dates: No trip dates, so this is a length recommendation rather than a timetable. Add dates in setup to get a day-by-day plan.
en.assumption_hours: {count} place(s) have no confirmed opening hours, so a window was assumed for them.
en.assumption_routes: Some travel times are estimated from distance rather than a looked-up route.
en.assumption_accommodation: No booked address, so every day starts and ends at the centre of your chosen places.
en.next_activate: Activating writes this draft as your itinerary. Old versions are kept, so nothing is lost and you can go back.
en.next_fix_first: This variant cannot be activated yet. Fix what the warnings name, or pick another variant, then generate again.
en.optimizing_note: Building three variants and checking each one. This takes about a minute — leave the tab open.
en.no_preview_help: Nothing has been drafted yet. Press the button above — it is free, nothing is committed, and you can throw the result away.
en.own_words_help: Write it in your own words, in any language. It is read for constraints when the plan is built — you do not need a special format.
en.tap_photo_hint: Tap the photo to see the next one.
en.stay_pace_title: How long should the trip be?
en.stay_pace_help: You have not set dates, so the planner sizes the trip instead of scheduling it. Pick a pace, then a rough time of year — it fills in provisional dates you can change later, and that is what unlocks the day-by-day timetable.
en.stay_pace_capacity: about {hours} h of visiting a day
en.pick_month_help: Any month works — this only sets a starting point. The exact dates are yours to edit in setup afterwards.
en.provisional_dates_set: Dates saved, and the places you already chose were re-linked to them — nothing to redo. Generate the plan below.
en.catalog_empty_help: This is almost always the map service being briefly unavailable, not the city having nothing in it. Wait a minute, then press Discover attractions again — it is free, and nothing you have entered is lost.
en.month_crowding_unknown: No public-holiday data for this country, so local crowding is unknown
en.month_guide_help: Ranked from {years} of recorded weather at your destination, plus its public holidays. Every month stays selectable — this is what the numbers say, not a rule.
en.month_guide_no_holidays: Public-holiday data is not published for {country}, so local crowding is not part of these rankings.
en.month_guide_free: Free — recorded weather and published holidays, no key and no charge.
en.month_crowded: {days}-day national holiday ({names}) — locals travel, so transport and hotels fill
en.month_festival: {names} happens this month and in no other
en.month_quiet: No national holiday, so it stays quiet
en.month_advice_heat: Plan indoor places for the afternoon, start early, and keep a rest stop each hour.
en.month_advice_cold: Keep outdoor stretches short and put a warm indoor stop between them.
en.month_advice_rain: Keep an indoor alternative beside each outdoor plan.
en.month_advice_crowds: Book transport and rooms early, and expect the well-known places to be full.
en.photo_is_nearby: Photographed near here, not necessarily of this place
